description: 16 missing lpn_ keys (the 2026-09-29 merges: paste messages, select/unselect on map, Shift hint, Lat/Lon abbreviations, fire-flow Selected design check) plus one REPLACE-IN-PLACE resync, lpn_lock_ask_prompt, whose English was corrected 2026-09-29 (the initials are kept on the server, not in the browser). x 26 languages. Wave 0 reviewed nothing: all 17 keys carry Tom's ruling on their exact English (dev/english-key-rulings.json), and wave0_keyset.php excludes ruled keys.

entries.complaint: Bengali has no customary short form for Latitude/Longitude (unlike Lat/Lon or N/E); invented period-truncated forms.
readings: spell out অক্ষাংশ/দ্রাঘিমাংশ despite narrow column
keep Latin tokens as northing/easting keep N/E
entries.resolution: A narrow column heading with no cross-language convention to match. Each agent chose a form it could defend inside its own file (Latin Lat/Lon where the file keeps N/E in Latin; native initials or short words where the file localizes N/E; two letters where one letter could not tell the two apart). Consistency inside one language is the rule; uniformity across languages is not required. No English change.

entries.complaint: 'Go to on map' has no object; Arabic wants one.
readings: bare verbal noun parallel to Select/Unselect on map (chosen)
add an implied pronoun object, whose gender may not fit every row
entries.resolution: "Go to on map" has no object for "to". Three agents flagged it (ar, ps, ru), and the shipped values split: de, hr, fa, ru, tr wrote "Show on map", while ro ("Mergi la pe hartă"), pt ("Ir para no mapa") and id ("Menuju di peta") calqued it word for word into something ungrammatical. It is the title on the row button that zooms to the element and selects it, beside lpn_pane_goto_tip "Zoom & select". Proposed English, for Tom: "Show on map". Once ruled, retranslate this one key in all 26.

entries.complaint: "Shift+click to add/remove toggle." has odd grammar: a noun phrase dangling after the infinitive.
readings: Shift+click toggles whether a click adds or removes
Shift+click adds, and some other gesture removes
entries.resolution: "Shift+click to add/remove toggle." leaves "toggle" dangling after the infinitive (it). Most languages rendered "Shift+click to add or remove", which is what the gesture does. Proposed English, for Tom: "Shift+click to add or remove one."

entries.resolution: "or set All" names no control: the option reads "All other junctions and all pipes" (lpn_ff_design_all).
